permitDetails.rightOfEntryClause:
42. Right of Entry - The permittee shall allow authorized local, state, and federal 
representatives, upon the presentation of credentials: 
 
 a. 
 To enter upon the permittee's premises on which the facility is located or in which any 
 records are required to be kept under the terms and conditions of this permit; 
 
 b. 
 To have access to and copy at reasonable times any records required to be kept under 
 the terms and conditions of this permit or the State Air Pollution Control Board 
 Regulations; 
 
 c. 
 To inspect at reasonable times any facility, equipment, or process subject to the terms 
 and conditions of this permit or the State Air Pollution Control Board Regulations; 
 and 
 
 d. 
 To sample or test at reasonable times. 
 
 For purposes of this condition, the time for inspection shall be deemed reasonable during 
 regular business hours or whenever the facility is in operation.  Nothing contained herein 
 shall make an inspection time unreasonable during an emergency. 
 (9 VAC 5-170-130 and 9 VAC 5-80-1180)

generatorSets.allowedOperatingModes: Emergency power generation (including grid failure, on-site disaster/equipment failure, and public service emergencies such as flood, fire, natural disaster, severe weather); participation in ISO-declared emergencies; periodic maintenance, testing, and operational training; non-emergency (alternate) power generation only after submitting documentation and receiving DEQ approval for the change in method of operation.
generatorSets.observationFrequency: not less than once each day the engine-generator set is operated

generatorSets.fuelChangePermitTrigger: A change in the fuel shall be considered a change in the method of operation of the engine-generator sets (Ref. Nos. EG04-EG547) and may require a new or amended permit. However, if a change in the fuel is not subject to new source review permitting requirements, this condition should not be construed to prohibit such a change.
generatorSets.control_technologies: Turbocharged engine and aftercooler; good operating practices and appropriate maintenance
generatorSets.operatingHoursRollingWindow: Consecutive 12-month rolling period, calculated monthly; compliance demonstrated monthly by adding the most recently completed calendar month to the totals for the preceding 11 months.
generatorSets.allowedOperatingModes: Emergency power generation due to sudden and reasonably unforeseeable disruptions of the primary power source (including failure of the electrical grid; on-site disaster or equipment failure; and public service emergencies such as flood, fire, natural disaster, or severe weather); participation in an ISO-declared emergency (including abnormal system conditions requiring action to maintain reliability or safety; capacity deficiency or excess; fuel shortage requiring departure from normal procedures; abnormal natural events or man-made threats requiring conservative operations; or an abnormal external event requiring ISO action); and periodic maintenance, testing, and operational training.
generatorSets.observationFrequency: with a frequency of not less than once each day the engine-generator set is operated.
